hotspots.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates
hotspots.blurb: Public exchanges between Donald Trump and Italian PM Giorgia Meloni have intensified, with Trump accusing Meloni of seeking political favor through a G7 photo and Meloni dismissing his claims as fabricated. The dispute has led to diplomatic tensions, including Italy canceling a U.S. visit by its foreign minister.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-profile nature, involving two major Western leaders, and the moral outrage it has sparked over perceived disrespect and diplomatic fallout.

hotspots.title: Adorni’s corruption scandal deepens

President Javier Milei has reshuffled his team, replacing Adorni as presidential spokesperson while retaining him in his current role.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the moral outrage over corruption allegations, the political instability it signals, and the polarized contention between government factions.
